messages:
Alex Chen: Quick sync — we need to lock the observability slice for Q2. Focus: tracing hook ergonomics, per-route cost breakdown, and error analytics. Thinking a 2-week pilot for customers A/B. Thoughts?
Jordan Patel: +1. we should separate infra effort vs UX. tracing hooks feel infra-heavy (sampling, span context) whereas cost breakdown is mostly UI + data pipeline.
Meera Singh: Agree. For error analytics we need an onboarding flow: map errors -> model + prompt + route. That's data-model work.
Sam Ortega: Customer asks: they want cost by 'route' and 'model-version' in the same view. Is that in-scope for MVP?
Alex Chen: MVP = per-route cost + a lightweight breakdown by model family (e.g., redwood/rlhf-v1). model-version foldout as "advanced". Keep rollout low-lift.
Jordan Patel: Can we do sampling-based tracing initially? full traces will kill storage/cost. propose: 1% sampling default, 10% for debug routes.
Meera Singh: +1 on sampling. Also propose a small payload for trace hooks: {trace_id, route, model, latency_ms, token_count, error_code}. Enough to power error analytics and cost attribution.
Sam Ortega: UX ask: show 3 slices — total spend, p95 latency, error rate — in a single dashboard row per route. Drilldown opens traces list (sampled).
Alex Chen: Good. Launch criteria: (1) per-route spend accurate within 5% on synthetic workloads; (2) trace payload available for >90% of sampled requests; (3) dashboard panels + drilldown with basic pagination.
Jordan Patel: Engineering notes: ETA 5 dev-weeks if we reuse existing billing joins. If we need a new aggregation pipeline it's 8+ weeks. Need decision by EOD Friday.
Meera Singh: I'll scope the data-model changes today. If we can map tokens -> cost at ingestion we avoid a heavy nightly job.
Sam Ortega: Also, add alerting hooks: a simple rule builder for error_rate > 1% or cost spike > 30% day-over-day. Not full rules engine, just a canned set for MVP.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: staging deployment succeeded for tracing-hook-proto (build 2026.03.19-1245).
Alex Chen: Next steps: Meera to post data-model ask, Jordan to confirm infra re-use, Sam to draft the dashboard wireframes by Wed. I'll collect firm estimations and decision Friday. :thumbsup:
